# Unspoken AI — LLM Context

Unspoken AI is an AI-powered conversation reply assistant for users aged 16 and older.

## What it does

Users upload a chat screenshot or paste conversation text. Unspoken AI analyses the conversation and generates three reply suggestions:
- Normal: natural and relaxed
- Rizz: confident and charming
- Flirty: playful and light

## Architecture

- Next.js 14 (App Router) with TypeScript
- Supabase Auth for authentication
- Google Gemini API (server-side only)
- Tailwind CSS v4

## Privacy

- Screenshots are not stored after processing
- Ephemeral in-memory analysis only
- No tracking or analytics

## Age restriction

16+ only. Verified server-side during registration.
